args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 production deploy. Rolled back all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollback verified successfully. v2.3.1 is now the only unhealthy production release; staging release v2.3.1-rc is also unhealthy and should be investigated before any re-deploy attempt.
args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary:

1. **Diagnosis**: Deployment history showed v2.3.1 was unhealthy in production; the most recent healthy release was v2.3.0.
2. **Rollback**: Rolled back checkout-api to **v2.3.0** in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) — rollout verified.
3. **Incident**: Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** (on-call paged) documenting the failing v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback to v2.3.0, and that the staging rc of v2.3.1 is also unhealthy — worth investigating before re-deploying.
4. **Verification**: checkout-api is now healthy again, running v2.3.0 across all regions with a low error rate (0.2%).
